units.source_text: 次晨天色已明，夕雾醒来，并不立刻起身。

en.t: The next morning, when it was already light, Yugiri woke but did not get up at once.

units.source_text: 云居雁被孩子们吵醒，走出外室去了。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari was awakened by the children and went out to the outer room.

units.source_text: 夕雾装作刚才醒来，起身在室中到处寻找，然而找不出来。

en.t: Yugiri pretended he had only just woken, got up, and searched all around the room, but he could not find it.

units.source_text: 云居雁看见他并不急欲找信，料想这不是情书，也就不把它放在心上。

en.t: Seeing that he was not urgently looking for the letter, Kumoi no Kari supposed it was not a love letter and paid it no mind.

units.source_text: 男孩子们蹦蹦跳跳地游戏，女孩子们玩娃娃，

en.t: The boys were jumping about at play, while the girls played with dolls,

units.source_text: 年纪稍长的读书习字，各自忙各自的。

en.t: and the slightly older children read books and practiced writing, each busy with their own task.

units.source_text: 还有很小的孩子，缠住了母亲，拖来拖去。

en.t: There were also very small children clinging to their mother and pulling her here and there.

units.source_text: 云居雁便把夺得的信完全忘却了。

en.t: Kumoi no Kari then completely forgot about the letter she had snatched away.

units.source_text: 夕雾除了这信以外，别的事全都不想。

en.t: Yugiri could think of nothing at all except that letter.

units.source_text: 他只想早些儿写回信去，然而昨夜的信不曾看得清楚。

en.t: He only wanted to write a reply as soon as possible, but he had not been able to read last night's letter clearly.

units.source_text: 不看来信而作复，老夫人将推想那信失落了。

en.t: If he replied without having read the incoming letter, the old lady would guess that it had been lost.

units.source_text: 他左思右想，心乱如麻。

en.t: He turned it over and over in his mind, his thoughts tangled in confusion.

units.source_text: 大家吃过早饭之后，日长人静，夕雾心中烦恼，对夫人说：

en.t: After everyone had eaten breakfast, the long day grew quiet, and Yugiri, troubled at heart, said to his wife:

units.source_text: “昨夜的信上不知写些什么，你死不肯给我看，真是奇怪。

en.t: "I do not know what was written in last night's letter, and it is truly strange that you absolutely refuse to show it to me.

units.source_text: 我今天应该前去探望，可是心情不佳，不能前往。

en.t: I ought to go and visit today, but I am in no fit state of mind and cannot go.

units.source_text: 我想写封信去，但不知来信写些什么。”

en.t: I want to send a letter, but I do not know what the letter I received says."

units.source_text: 说时态度淡然。

en.t: As he spoke, his manner was perfectly casual.

units.source_text: 云居雁想想，夺取这封信实在没有意思，

en.t: Kumoi no Kari thought it over and realized that snatching this letter had really been pointless,

units.source_text: 觉得难以为情，便不再提此事，答道：

en.t: and feeling embarrassed, she did not bring up the matter again but answered:

units.source_text: “你只要说前晚在深山中受了风寒，身上不好，不能出门，

en.t: "You need only say that the night before last you caught a chill in the deep mountains, feel unwell, and cannot go out,

units.source_text: 婉言道歉就得了。”

en.t: and then offer a polite apology. That will be enough."

units.source_text: 夕雾开玩笑地说：“算了吧！

en.t: Yugiri said jokingly, "Enough of that!

units.source_text: 不要只管说这些无聊的话！

en.t: Do not keep saying such pointless things.

units.source_text: 有什么意思呢？

en.t: What meaning could there be in it?

units.source_text: 你把我看作世间普通的色情男子，反而可耻。

en.t: It is shameful that you should take me for an ordinary lustful man of the world.

units.source_text: 这里的侍女们看见你在我这个不识风情的人面前说这种醋话，都觉得好笑呢。”

en.t: The ladies here will find it amusing to see you speak such jealous words before someone as unromantic as me."

units.source_text: 接着便问：“那封信到底藏在哪里了？”

en.t: Then he asked, "Where on earth have you hidden that letter?"

units.source_text: 云居雁并不立刻拿出信来，于是只得照旧和她谈东说西，

en.t: Kumoi no Kari did not bring out the letter at once, so he had no choice but to chat with her as usual about one thing and another,

units.source_text: 暂时躺着休息一会，不觉日色已暮。

en.t: and after lying down to rest for a while, he found before he knew it that evening had already fallen.
